label: v197
changes: A document read that never finished no longer spins for ever. If the app closed, the connection dropped, or a long scanned document stalled while it was being read, that message came back as a permanent "Reading…" with no way out — and it stayed that way through every reload. It now says the read didn't finish and gives you a "Try reading it again" button.
Every failed read has a way forward. Previously a read that errored was a dead end: no answer, and nothing on screen that could go and get it.
